title: ECOKV: Geometry-Aware KV Cache Eviction via Complementary Diversity Metrics
abstract: arXiv:2609.06663v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Although multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) excel in diverse tasks, their scalability remains limited by the memory and computational overhead of KV cache storage. Recent KV cache eviction approaches incorporate a cosine similarity-based diversity metric with importance metrics to selectively retain critical key-value pairs. However, cosine similarity involves normalization that discards magnitude information, and it often yields uniformly high similarity values across layers due to the anisotropy property of hidden representations. In our study ECOKV, we rigorously deconstruct the capabilities of existing diversity metrics. Moving beyond simple measurement, we propose a geometry-aware composite metric that jointly leverages Euclidean distance and cosine similarity to capture token diversity from complementary perspectives. translated_title: ECOKV：基于互补多样性度量的几何感知KV缓存驱逐
translated_abstract: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在多种任务中表现出色，但其可扩展性仍然受到KV缓存存储的内存和计算开销的限制。近期的KV缓存驱逐方法将基于余弦相似度的多样性度量与重要性度量相结合，以选择性地保留关键的键值对。然而，余弦相似度涉及归一化操作，会丢弃幅度信息，并且由于隐藏表示的各向异性特性，它往往在各层产生普遍偏高的相似度值。在我们的ECOKV研究中，我们严格解构了现有多样性度量的能力。我们超越了简单的度量方式，提出了一种几何感知的复合度量，联合利用欧几里得距离和余弦相似度从互补的角度捕获token的多样性。此外，我们使用这两种度量来估计每个注意力头的冗余水平，从而实现自适……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ECOKV提出了一种几何感知的复合多样性度量，联合利用欧几里得距离和余弦相似度从互补视角捕获token多样性，并据此估计各注意力头的冗余水平，从而更有效地对多模态大语言模型进行KV缓存驱逐。
en_tdlr: ECOKV proposes a geometry-aware composite diversity metric that jointly leverages Euclidean distance and cosine similarity to capture token diversity from complementary perspectives, and uses these metrics to estimate per-attention-head redundancy for more effective KV cache eviction in multimodal LLMs.
